summary: Symbol.for is implemented in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/symbol/for.rs and follows the spec steps in order. Step 1 calls ops::to_string(agent, key)? and propagates errors. Step 4 is a linear scan of agent.symbol_registry, matching by string content, and returns the existing symbol. Steps 6 and 7 create a symbol with agent.new_symbol(Some(string_key)) and push (key, symbol) onto the registry. Step 8 returns the new symbol. Each step keeps its spec comment directly above its code. Renaming this and new_target to underscore-prefixed names is needed because the old `let _ = (...)` line was removed, so it is not an unrelated change. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The gate report (build, clippy, 10 new test262 passes, no regressions) is consistent with the diff. Caveat: I could not see the Agent definitions of symbol_registry, str or new_symbol, so their semantics are inferred from the build passing and from their use here.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. The lookup is O(n) with a string allocation per entry if agent.str allocates, which is a performance concern only and not a spec issue. Nothing else to fix in this ticket.
